hvg_method: log1p library-size-normalized RNA; variance z-score within 20 mean-expression bins; not Seurat VST
clustering: RNA-only weighted kNN Louvain; not authors multimodal WNN reproduction
T_enriched_rule: >=20 nuclei; >=30% expressing >=1 CD3D/E/G and >=30% expressing >=1 CD247/LCK/CD2; <20% with >=2 myeloid or B markers. Exploratory cluster label, not validated annotation.
limitations: No doublet detection or full ATAC QC
Cluster annotation thresholds exploratory; not purity estimates
Target ATAC counts not used for clustering or annotation
